_what: directional check of the fingerprint value gradient
verdict: gradient ASCENDS the guide reward (plumbing correct)
_verdict_note: WARNING, added 2026-09-29 after this file was written. The `verdict` field below was produced by the OLD grad-sign verdict logic (max of the positive deltas > 0), which compares the single best probe against step 0 and is NOT a sign test. Read properly, this scan's own guide_reward_by_step favours -grad at every |step| >= 0.1. The scan cannot settle the sign at any step size: at steps small enough to be linear its Monte-Carlo noise (fresh look-aheads) is ~1e4 times its signal, and at steps large enough to beat the noise it displaces every atom by 0.34-3.4 Angstrom. The verdict string was removed from the code; `multimfm.geom.diagnostics grad-sign` now prints the paired +/- comparison and declares itself underpowered. The sign and magnitude are established instead by fd_check_t0.5_lam0.01_cuda.json (FD ratio 1.006 for grad V), fd_check_reward_only.json (1.0003 for dr/dcoords), scripts/geom/sign_chain_selfcheck.py (analytic, exact to 7 digits) and the -mu sign test in guidance_grid.csv. See docs/geom_guidance_diagnosis.md section 2.2.
